t.zh: 分析彩色照片时，关注不同颜色可能突出不同的结构；细碎变化又可能影响边缘的观察。组合已有元件，按 wr、wg、wb 选择颜色权重，用<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>平滑图像，再用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>的强度元件分析变化。输出处理后的图像和对应的边缘强度。
t.en: In a colour photograph, different colour mixtures can reveal different structures, while fine variation can affect edge analysis. Combine the existing parts: choose colour weights wr, wg and wb, smooth the image with <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>, and use the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> strength part to analyse change. Output the processed image and its edge strength.

after.zh: 这次<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>不只把部件摆在一起：权重决定看哪些<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>，平滑改变进入求变化部件的信号。两张输出让你检查“保留了什么”与“哪里变化强”；这仍是局部处理，不等于识别物体。
after.en: This <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref> composes a real signal path: weights select <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> and smoothing changes what reaches the change detector. The two outputs show what remains and where it changes strongly. These local operations do not recognise objects. (colour channel)

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>：在元件上设定取第几个位置。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>; set on the part which position it takes.

brief.zh: 输入彩色图与 wr、wg、wb：out 为各<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>模糊后按权重相加的图，mag 为 out 的边缘强度。两路输出均需接出。
brief.en: Given a colour image and wr, wg, wb: out is the weighted sum of blurred <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>, and mag is its edge strength. Connect both outputs. (colour channel)

hint.zh: 先把三个<wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref>分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
hint.en: First take the three <wiki-ref to="colour-channel"></wiki-ref> apart, blur each, then weight them. (colour channel)
